Kuvitus: koulun laboratorion työpöytä. V: Illustration: a workbench in a school laboratory. On the left, a measuring cylinder with liquid stands on a digital balance, and a bottle is beside it. In the middle is an open notebook: on the left page a table of measurements and on the right page a graph whose points, with their error bars, are scattered slightly around one fitted straight line. On the right of the bench are a ruler and a stopwatch.
Kaavio: mittauksesta tulokseen viidessä: Diagram: from measurement to result in five steps joined by downward arrows. 1 Measure: reading, uncertainty Δx and precision. 2 Graph: quantity and unit on the axes. 3 Fit: straight line or linearisation. 4 Interpret: slope k and constant term b with their units. 5 Result: k ± Δk and the range of validity of the model.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa, keksitty esimerkk: Graph to scale, invented example data: the temperature θ of water in degrees Celsius as a function of the time t in minutes. Six measurement points at the moments 1–6 min, each with a vertical uncertainty bar of ±1 °C. A solid straight line θ = 6.2 °C/min · t + 19 °C is fitted among the points, and dashed lines show the steepest and the shallowest line that still pass through all the bars. A triangle is drawn on the line between the points t = 1 min and t = 6 min, which are far apart: the horizontal side is Δt and the vertical side Δθ, and the slope is k = Δθ/Δt. The line crosses the vertical axis at b, which is the initial temperature. In the lower right corner a legend says that the dashed line means the steepest and the shallowest line.
Kaksi kuvaajaa samasta mallin aineistost: Two graphs of the same model data: a trolley accelerating uniformly from rest, acceleration 0.50 m/s². On the left, the distance s in metres as a function of the time t: six points at the moments 0.5–3.0 s lie on a curve that bends upwards. On the right, the same distance as a function of the square of the time t²: the points are on a straight line through the origin whose slope is half the acceleration, 0.25 m/s².
Kuvaaja: mittalasin ja nesteen yhteismas: Graph: the total mass m of the measuring cylinder and the liquid in grams as a function of the volume V of the liquid in millilitres. Horizontal axis 0–110 ml and vertical axis 100–220 g, with its starting value marked. Eight blue points form a rising row at the volumes 20–100 ml, and each has a horizontal uncertainty bar of ±1 ml. The point of the row 60 ml (60 ml; 183.4 g) is drawn as a hollow red circle: it is clearly above the others, at almost the same height as the point 70 ml.
Kuvaaja: sama aineisto kuin edellä. Kahd: Graph: the same data as above. One straight line is fitted among the eight reliable points and extended as a dashed line to the vertical axis; it crosses the axis at about 118.6 g, which is the mass of the empty measuring cylinder. The points (20 ml; 137.0 g) and (100 ml; 210.5 g), far apart and read from the line, are circled, so the slope is 0.919 g/ml. The grey dashed lines are the steepest and the shallowest line, with slopes 0.932 and 0.908 g/ml. The line passes the hollow point 60 ml at a distance of about 10 g.
Kuvaaja: leluauton paikka x metreinä aja: Graph: the position x of a toy car in metres as a function of the time t in seconds, 0–3.0 s. Six blue points are close to one rising straight line; the position uncertainty ±0.03 m is smaller than the size of a point, so the uncertainty bars stay inside the points. The point (1.5 s; 1.32 m) is drawn as a hollow red circle: it is about 0.25 m above the line. The line crosses the vertical axis at 0.36 m, not at the origin, and its slope is 0.48 m/s. The points (0 s; 0.36 m) and (3.0 s; 1.79 m) read from the line are circled.
Kuvaaja: ruiskun asteikon tilavuus V mil: Graph: the volume V on the syringe scale in millilitres as a function of the reciprocal of the pressure 1/p in the unit 1/MPa. Ten blue points between 5.3 and 12.2 1/MPa are on one rising straight line. The line is extended as a dashed line to the vertical axis, which it crosses on the negative side at −1.8 ml. The slope is 2.60 MPa · ml. The horizontal axis is drawn at V = 0.
